Definition: from a compound of G1722 and G3563; thoughtfulness, i.e. moral understanding:--intent, mind.
BiblicalUsage: Thought, intent — the mind's purpose. Peter says to arm yourselves with the same mind as Christ who suffered in the flesh in 1 Peter 4:1, and Hebrews says the word of God discerns the thoughts and intents of the heart in Hebrews 4:12.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe my intents are not hidden from God, and the word that discerns them is the same word that arms me with Christ's mind.
